name: plug_star
source: Christmas/solidcraft/plug_star.sc (SolidCraft 0.45; Plug_star_v1.sc). Equations and checks: plugstar_spec.md

shape._comment: connector constants of the .sc at scale 1; every length is multiplied by sc = max(1, D / scale_from). tk connector thickness, wt tongue width over both prongs, sw slit between the prongs, bd barb depth, bl barb land, lp prong length (slit end to the catch face), hub_m (hub radius rh = (wt/2 + hub_m)/tan(phi)), slit_m (slit end beyond the hub), hang_d hanging hole, hang_m material beside it in the outline, hang_t star thickness at its edge (the hole sits as far in as either needs). Checks: min_wall over the barb pocket, min_jaw over the hub slot at the side faces, min_hang distance of the hanging hole from the barb pocket

help.en: mm, the circle through the tips
help.de: mm, der Kreis durch die Spitzen

help.en: every point is its own part
help.de: jede Zacke ist ein eigenes Teil

help.en: degrees, how slim the points are
help.de: Grad, wie schlank die Zacken sind

help.en: at the centre, % of the diameter
play around the connector: 0.15 mm clicked best in PLA, 0.20 mm for other materials
help.de: Spiel am Steckkreuz: 0,15 mm rastet in PLA am besten, 0,20 mm für andere Materialien
